what: A variable created with `const` cannot be reassigned. The value was locked when it was declared, so the later assignment throws a TypeError.

street.headline: You try change `const`
street.happen: You use `const` lock `age`, then you wan change am. E no go gree.
street.todo: If the value go change, use `let`:
street.learn: "constant" mean value wey no dey change.
